items.colloc: high absenteeism 高缺席率 | reduce absenteeism 減少曠職
items.distinct: absence 缺席 | vacancy 空缺
ex: High absenteeism affects our overall productivity.
高曠職率影響了我們的整體生產力。
Management is concerned about rising absenteeism.
管理階層對於日益增加的缺席率感到擔憂。
We need to investigate the cause of absenteeism.
我們需要調查導致缺席的原因。

items.colloc: annual leave 年假 | sick leave 病假
items.distinct: vacation 假期 | holiday 節日
ex: She applied for sick leave this morning.
她今天早上申請了病假。
Please submit your leave request online.
請在線上提交您的請假申請。
He is currently on unpaid leave.
他目前正在留職停薪。

items.colloc: check attendance 點名 | perfect attendance 全勤
items.distinct: attention 注意力 | tendency 趨勢
ex: Daily attendance is tracked by the system.
每日出勤由系統追蹤。
He has a record of perfect attendance.
他擁有全勤的出勤紀錄。
Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
請在週五前確認您的出席。

items.colloc: request time-off 申請休假 | take time-off 請假
items.distinct: break 休息 | leisure 閒暇
ex: Staff may request time-off for personal reasons.
員工可因個人理由申請休假。
He needs some time-off to recover.
他需要一些休假時間來恢復。
Management approved her request for time-off.
管理層核准了她的休假申請。

items.colloc: compensatory leave 補休 | compensatory time 補償時間
items.distinct: complementary 補充的 | competitive 競爭的
ex: She received compensatory leave for working weekends.
她因週末工作獲得了補休。
We provide compensatory time for extra hours.
我們針對加班提供補償時間。
This policy offers compensatory benefits to staff.
這項政策提供員工補償性福利。

items.colloc: duty roster 值勤表 | update the roster 更新名冊
items.distinct: schedule 行程表 | register 登記簿
ex: Check the duty roster for your shifts.
請查看值勤表確認您的排班。
The new staff member is on the roster.
新進員工已列入名冊中。
Please post the weekly roster tomorrow.
請在明天公佈每週排班表。

items.colloc: night shift 夜班 | change shifts 換班
items.distinct: move 移動 | turn 轉彎
ex: She prefers working the morning shift.
她比較喜歡上早班。
The night shift starts at midnight.
夜班於午夜開始。
We need to adjust our working shifts.
我們需要調整工作班次。

items.colloc: clock-in time 打卡時間 | clock-in system 打卡系統
items.distinct: clock-out 下班打卡 | login 登入
ex: Please clock-in upon arriving at work.
請在抵達公司時打卡。
The clock-in system is currently malfunctioning.
打卡系統目前故障。
He forgot to clock-in this morning.
他今天早上忘了打卡。

items.colloc: maintain punctuality 保持準時 | value punctuality 重視準時
items.distinct: precision 精確 | accuracy 正確
ex: Punctuality is essential for all employees.
準時對於所有員工來說至關重要。
We value punctuality during project meetings.
我們在專案會議期間很重視準時。
His punctuality has improved significantly lately.
他近期的準時表現顯著改善。

items.colloc: engage in shift-work 從事輪班 | shift-work schedule 輪班表
items.distinct: part-time 兼職 | freelance 接案
ex: Many employees prefer flexible shift-work hours.
許多員工偏好彈性的輪班工作時間。
Shift-work can be quite demanding physically.
輪班工作在體力上可能相當吃力。
The factory operates on a shift-work basis.
工廠是以輪班制的方式運作。

items.colloc: adopt flexitime 採用彈性工時 | flexitime policy 彈性工時政策
items.distinct: full-time 全職 | overtime 加班
ex: Our company recently introduced a flexitime policy.
我們公司最近引進了彈性工時政策。
Flexitime helps employees balance their work.
彈性工時有助於員工平衡工作。
She takes advantage of the flexitime system.
她善用了彈性工時制度。

items.colloc: written authorization 書面批准 | obtain authorization 取得授權
items.distinct: authority 權力 | authentication 驗證
ex: You need authorization before taking leave.
你在休假前需要取得批准。
He did not get authorization for overtime.
他沒有取得加班的授權。
Submit the form to gain authorization.
請提交表格以獲得批准。

items.colloc: casual labor 臨時勞工 | casual day 便服日
items.distinct: formal 正式的 | regular 規律的
ex: The company hired several casual workers.
公司僱用了幾名臨時工。
Today is casual day at the office.
今天是辦公室的便服日。
Casual leave is not provided for interns.
實習生不提供事假。

items.colloc: leave of absence 請假 | record of absence 缺席紀錄
items.distinct: absent 缺席的 | presence 出席
ex: Please report your absence to the manager.
請向經理回報您的缺勤。
His absence caused a delay in tasks.
他的缺席導致任務延遲。
She was granted a brief leave of absence.
她獲准了一次短暫的休假。

items.colloc: heavy workload 沈重工作量 | manage workload 管理工作量
items.distinct: workforce 勞動力 | workflow 工作流程
ex: The team is struggling with a heavy workload.
團隊正為了龐大的工作量而掙扎。
We must distribute the workload more evenly.
我們必須更平均地分配工作量。
Increased tasks result in a larger workload.
增加的任務導致了更大的工作量。

items.colloc: prolonged absence 長期缺席 | prolonged exposure 長期接觸
items.distinct: extended 延伸的 | delayed 延遲的
ex: His prolonged absence affected the project timeline.
他的長期缺席影響了專案進度。
They suffered from prolonged working hours.
他們飽受長時間工作的困擾。
We need to avoid prolonged downtime.
我們需要避免長時間的停機。

items.colloc: physical exhaustion 體力耗盡 | mental exhaustion 心力交瘁
items.distinct: fatigue 疲勞 | burnout 職業倦怠
ex: He took a break due to exhaustion.
他因為過度疲憊而休息。
Working overtime leads to mental exhaustion.
加班會導致心力交瘁。
The staff showed signs of extreme exhaustion.
員工顯露出極度疲憊的跡象。

items.colloc: deadline for submission 提交期限 | submission of reports 報告呈遞
items.distinct: permission 許可 | commission 佣金
ex: Please ensure the timely submission of reports.
請確保報告能及時提交。
The submission date has been postponed again.
提交日期又被延後了。
He finished his submission before the deadline.
他在期限前完成了提交。
